name: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions
summary: In eastern Elwynn, Rolf and Malakai's Medallions bear the realm's insignia, though their owners vanished on patrol. Guard Thomas seeks the tokens to learn what became of his men.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Guard Thomas commands the station in eastern Elwynn. When Rolf and Malakai vanished along the riverbanks, he feared the worst. Their medallions confirm the guards died at the hands of encroaching murlocs. The Stormwind garrison has lost soldiers who held the line against wilderness threats while the kingdom's military was stretched thin.

sections.title: Tokens of Service
sections.body: Human guards carry identification medallions on city watch and rural patrols. The tokens show their allegiance and authority under the crown. Returning Rolf and Malakai's medallions to Guard Thomas lets him account for his missing men and record their sacrifice in his field report. He can also warn of aggressive murloc tribes settling near the trade roads.

faq.q: What are Rolf and Malakai's Medallions?
faq.answer: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions are service identification tokens carried by Stormwind guards. Murlocs ambushed and killed the guards while they were posted in eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who do these medallions belong to?
faq.answer: The medallions belonged to Guards Rolf and Malakai. They served under Guard Thomas, watching the river and roads between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Who should I bring these medallions to?
aliases: where do i turn these in
faq.answer: Bring the medallions to Guard Thomas. He keeps watch at the eastern bridge on the road between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Why are these medallions important to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas sent both guards on patrol and feared they had met a foul end. Their medallions confirm their deaths, letting him record their sacrifice and warn Stormwind of the rising murloc threat.

angles.text: Even in the heart of the Alliance, local guardsmen face deadly peril while guarding rural trade routes.
For humans of Elwynn, these tokens mark the loss of sons and defenders. Their deaths show the kingdom's vulnerability while its military is occupied elsewhere.
